summary: A Quote subscription on an NSE equity: TradeSmart's touchline snapshot (tk) gives a Quote frame with every quote field, a partial update (tf) overlays it and its zero open keeps the cached one, and after the unsubscribe a frame still in flight reaches nobody.

notes: Noren's feed time ft goes out as the member's timestamp key in seconds, as on the web; its trade time ltt (HH:MM:SS) is not copied as text, and the Noren family sends no ltt key (docs/port/market-data-frames.md; audit FB-07).

deviations.reason: The stream carries no OI for this instrument (a cash equity or an index); the web's TradeSmart adapter sends its safe_float/safe_int default (0) for a field the stream did not carry; the docs leave such a field out (web openalgo#2376, docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md), and so does the desktop.
